primary_comparison: GNN minus MLP at n=24: seed-paired mean optimality ratio
uncertainty: Five training seeds are the replication unit. Two-sided Student-t intervals (df=4) on seed means or paired differences; descriptive, not multiplicity-adjusted. Report all planned learned-control contrasts; no selective significance claims.
hyperparameters: Original common CEM settings: 256 rollouts, top 20 percent per size, AdamW 3e-4, decay 1e-4, two epochs, clip 1.0; no tuning. Width GNN/endpoint/candidate 64, MLP 67; only GNN has three message-passing layers.
curriculum: [6,8,10,12,14]. Validate 100 episodes per introduced size every five iterations, fresh seeds keyed to step; advance after two newest-size mean ratios >= .97, at most 100 iterations per stage. Restore best mean-across-introduced model AND optimizer at each transition. Final selected checkpoint is the best validation model within the final stage.
fixed_budget: Save current model immediately after iteration 50, before any stage restoration. Exactly 12800 training rollouts; actions, update counts and size exposure can differ. Evaluate at n=14,24 with the same frozen evaluation seeds. No equal-wall-time or equal-update claim.
resource_plan: Post-optimization timing-only pilot: eight untrained n40 GNN episodes 1.93 seconds, candidate 1.60, endpoint 1.81; lookahead pilot 1.28. Four independent one-thread CPU workers. 20 training runs, <=10000 aggregate iterations, 870 main evaluation cells/87000 graphs, 40 budget cells/4000 graphs. 100 episodes chosen before comparative outcomes to keep full parity/size/control coverage practical. No optional seed expansion.
timing: Generation only, batch elapsed/count is amortized throughput cost, not individual latency. Diagnostic replay excluded. Concurrent-run timings are descriptive; do not infer architecture speed superiority. Separate serial latency profile where practical.
unsupported: MLP and untrained MLP n>24 are unsupported and excluded, never scored as failures.
failures: Preserve failure record and partial evidence; do not substitute a new seed. Resume only identical contracts. A failed or incomplete cohort cannot support the complete planned comparison.
holdout: n16/20/24 already inspected historically. Odd interpolation n7/9/11/13 and new extrapolation n15/17/23/25/30/40 frozen before evaluation; no model selection on them.
representation: Exhibited C8 limitation plus a small exact continuation collection. For first 10 episodes/seed/family at n14/24/40, measure sufficient symbolic mean-message-passing equivalence, mixed-value groups, first-loss bad mass and unavoidable alias states. Oracle annotations do not enter rewards or primary inputs.
intervention_gate: Only if trajectory diagnostics support consequential aliasing, preregister a separate additional-information intervention and an information-matched simple control. Otherwise report the architectural example and observational limits without an unsupported remedy claim.
